technical_issues.issue: WannaCry figure cited as 81 of 236 English trusts; the NAO report gives 80 trusts (plus 603 primary care organisations). Minor factual slippage but attributed to a reputable source.
States six patients received massive overdoses but omits that three died; the mortality outcome would strengthen the harm argument.
Introduction-to-conclusion text may exceed the 1,500-word limit stated in the brief; word count is not declared, so compliance cannot be verified.

overall: A strong, well-evidenced report: clear ethical framing, balanced argument, four relevant external cases, a practical decision flowchart and stakeholder-specific recommendations. Minor numeric imprecision on the WannaCry scale and an unverified word count are the only concerns.
